text: As Potter and his bride rounded the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> Near their new home. <break time="0.8s" /> They came face to face with a man. <break time="0.8s" /> In a maroon colored shirt. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was feverishly reloading. <break time="0.8s" /> In an instant. <break time="0.8s" /> The man dropped the revolver to the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> And like lightning. <break time="0.8s" /> Whipped another from its holster. <break time="0.8s" /> And aimed it at the bridegrooms chest. <break time="0.8s" /> The brides face had gone. <break time="0.8s" /> As yellow as old cloth. <break time="0.8s" /> And Potter. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had no weapon with him. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood perfectly still. <break time="0.8s" /> Before the gleaming revolver. <break time="0.8s" /> You tried to sneak up on me. <break time="0.8s" /> Scratchy said with a sneer. <break time="0.8s" /> And when Potter calmly answered. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had no gun with him. <break time="0.8s" /> Scratchy refused to believe it. <break time="0.8s" /> I have no gun. <break time="0.8s" /> Because I have just come from San Antonio. <break time="0.8s" /> With my wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Potter distinctly. <break time="0.8s" /> And I am married, Scratchy. <break time="0.8s" /> Married, said Scratchy. <break time="0.8s" /> And like a creature allowed a glimpse of another world. <break time="0.8s" /> He stepped back and asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Is this the lady. <break time="0.8s" /> When Potter said yes. <break time="0.8s" /> Scratchy said slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, I suppose it is all off now. <break time="0.8s" /> For he was only a simple child. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the earlier plains. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his fallen revolver. <break time="0.8s" /> Put both weapons in their holsters. <break time="0.8s" /> And went away. <break time="0.8s" /> And his feet made funnel shaped tracks. <break time="0.8s" /> In the heavy sand.
